payload.prompt:
Summer errands shouldn't come with a restroom scavenger hunt. We're Xylohaven Civic Works, a small civic business based in Portland, Oregon, and our Summer Relief Petition is our big project this season. The idea grew out of those downtown trips where finding a toilet somehow becomes the longest stop. We're asking towns across the United States to adopt a requirement for free public toilets in town centers, with daily opening hours and a funded cleaning schedule. This is an invented, nonpartisan civic proposal.

Here's the copy from our landing page: "We're Xylohaven Civic Works, based in Portland, Oregon, working for better public toilet access in town centers across the United States. Our Summer Relief Petition asks towns to adopt a policy requiring free public toilets in their centers, with daily opening hours and a funded cleaning schedule. Sign for free by July 20, 2027, and help make summer errands possible without buying something just to use a restroom. Signatures are open only to United States residents aged 18 or older, under our petition's eligibility policy."

Please send people to https://xylohavencivic.org/summer-relief. We want as many petition sign-ups as possible; we count each completed petition signature as one sign-up. Our eligibility policy means only United States residents aged 18 or older can sign.

Run the campaign from Friday, July 16, 2027 through Tuesday, July 20, 2027, inclusive: five days in our account's time zone, Pacific time. Our site does not have X's pixel, so X can't see the sign-ups. Because we're advocating a policy change, X counts these ads as political campaigning. X has approved our account for political campaigning ads in the United States.

You may launch and manage the campaign on your own without asking us for approval. Please watch it throughout the flight and make adjustments as needed. At the end, send us a short recap with spend, impressions and link clicks. We'd love to get more names behind a very everyday need.

Total budget: 1,000.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 2 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:
